title: Margaritas and Murder at El Paso: The Patio Witness
venue: El Paso Mexican Restaurant — Denham Springs
series_title: Margaritas and Murder at El Paso

title_screen.subtitle: A Live Detective Mystery Experience
title_screen.hook: A patio server collapses during a busy dinner set, and the music never stops long enough for the truth to be heard.

truth.motive: Carmen overheard the musician threatening to expose a fake charity tip jar scam
truth.method: Carmen was poisoned through a staff-only lime garnish bottle kept near the patio bar
truth.strongest_evidence: The lime bottle fingerprint and refill timing place the musician at the patio bar before Carmen collapsed
truth.red_herring: The rival restaurateur's angry social post

briefing.host_read: Tonight at El Paso, dinner service turns into a crime scene. The salsa music is still playing, the patio lights are still warm, and every suspect has a reason to protect their own version of the night. Detectives, follow the receipts, the hallway timing, the patio noise, and what the staff tried to clean up before anyone called for help.
briefing.player_prompt: Review each app as clues unlock. Use the round checkpoints to organize what the evidence actually proves. Do not accuse on gossip alone.

clue_theme: patio sound gaps, lime bottle access, charity jar receipts, staff bar timing

0.public: Carmen Vega collapses near the patio service station. At first, everyone blames heat, stress, and a packed dinner rush.

entries.title: Scene Note
entries.content: Carmen's last drink was staff water with fresh lime from the patio bottle.

300.public: The patio band covered more than music. It covered a short movement gap.

entries.title: Patio Movement
entries.content: Musician left the mic stand during a long instrumental break.

entries.title: Patio Bar Image
entries.content: Lime bottle moved from left rail to back counter between photos.

600.public: A rival restaurant post looks ugly, but it does not explain the staff-only garnish bottle.

entries.title: Rival Post
entries.content: Public insult posted before dinner. No access to staff patio station shown.

900.public: Carmen had been asking about a tip jar that did not match the event receipts.

entries.title: Charity Jar Count
entries.content: Cash total is short compared with guest photos and table receipts.

entries.title: Carmen Draft
entries.content: I know where the patio tips are really going.

1200.public: The timing turns from suspicious to narrow: only one person moved while the patio attention was pulled to the music.

entries.title: Witness Call
entries.content: Guest remembers applause starting as the musician stepped toward the service bar.

1500.public: The poison source was not Carmen's table drink. It was the garnish bottle shared by staff water refills.

entries.title: Recovered Search
entries.content: symptoms poison citrus bottle small amount

1800.public: The patio witness died because she heard the wrong thing and touched the wrong bottle.

entries.title: Final Lab Note
entries.content: Lime bottle fingerprint and refill timing place the musician at the patio bar before Carmen collapsed.

reveal_copy: The truth points to Patio Musician. The strongest case is not built on the loudest rumor, but on how motive, method, opportunity, and the evidence trail line up. The detail that closes it: The lime bottle fingerprint and refill timing place the musician at the patio bar before Carmen collapsed.
